o1: Enables mitogen-activated protein kinase binding activity and protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in negative regulation of microtubule severing during mitosis; positive regulation of microtubule severing during meiosis; positive regulation of endocytic recycling; regulation of Golgi organization; and regulation of oocyte development. Is located in cytoplasm and cytoplasmic side of apical plasma membrane. Interacts with FARL-11; SLMP-1; LET-92; CASH-1; and CCM-3. Used to study cerebral cavernous malformation. Orthologous to several human genes including STK26 (serine/threonine kinase 26).
